facts.text: I filmed Santa on my camera. Tonight I'm leaving cookies by the tree and keeping the camera running.
facts.why: The plot summary has Kate and Teddy setting a tripwire and hidden camera together, and later 'Kate's video' of the adventure. Teddy filming Santa himself is not shown, so the note puts the camera on the wrong child.
facts.fix: Kate and I set a tripwire and hid the camera. There are cookies by the tree and the camera's running.

facts.why: Sources opened say Kate and Teddy set up a hidden camera together and call the final video 'Kate's video'. Whose camcorder it is was not settled.

facts.text: Snacking while Teddy's camcorder runs all night.
facts.why: Same camera problem. They fall asleep in the living room and the camera is hidden, and the video is called Kate's.
facts.fix: Snacking while the hidden camera runs all night.

vibe.verdict: A generic cosy Christmas kitchen. It ignores the actual adventure, the stolen car, the Chicago crash and the jailhouse sing-along.
missing: The red Dodge Challenger car chase

ideas: Swap 'Stakeout salted caramel choc chip cookies' for 'Jailhouse sing-along cookies' after the holding cell scene.
Swap 'Pierce family bacon-wrapped meatloaf' for a Chicago-crash special.
